description: This file defines custom exception handlers for FastAPI, including handlers for HTTP exceptions, request validation errors, and WebSocket validation errors.

methods.name: Response http_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: HTTPException)
methods.description: Handles general HTTP exceptions, returning a JSON response or a simple Response based on the status code.

methods.name: JSONResponse request_validation_exception_handler( request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError )
methods.description: Handles request validation errors, returning a JSON response with error details.

methods.name: None websocket_request_validation_exception_handler( websocket: WebSocket, exc: WebSocketRequestValidationError )
methods.description: Handles WebSocket validation errors by closing the WebSocket connection with a policy violation code and error details.

ctags.name: http_exception_handler
ctags.pattern: /^async def http_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: HTTPException) -> Response:$/
